title: Akhay Zainab Chum ke Kattiyan Baawan Ghazi
body:
Rawaan Okhiyan Shaam Diyan Ne, Kevain Shaam Nu Jaawan Ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
Tere Aasray Turdi Turdi, Veeran Mai Karbal Wich Aagayi
Dasvi De Din Maut Haneri, Mere Saarey Veer Muka Gayi
Hunr Mai Khaymeya Wich Marjawan x2, Ya Mai Deen Bachawan Ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
Tere Bajon Veeran Ghazi, Ummat Ne Ki Zulam Kamaaye
Mere Pyase Veeran Maran, Ral Ke Saray Zalin Aaaye
Hunr Mai Kaatilan Kolon Apna x2, Kevain Deen Batawan Ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
Ban Ke Qaidi Shaam Nu Challiyan, Laikay Apniyan Kinj Bharjaiyan
Hattaan De Wich Rassiyan Paa Ke, Veeran Teri Laash Te Aaiyaan
Sir Te Mere Chaadar Koi Nai x2, Kevain Waal Lukawaan Ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
Ruldi Ruldi Kufay De Wich, Veeran Mai Hunr Shaam’ch Aagayi
Khooni Barish Pathraan Di Ay, Veeran Teri Maut Bhulagayi
Hunr Mai Das Quraan Sunawaan x2, Ya Sajjad Bachawan Ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
Lath Gaye Ne War Qaidiyan Walay, Mil Gayi Veeran Qaid Rihaai
Kar Ke Shahid Deen Mukammal, Veeran Mai Karbal Wich Aayi
Reh Gaye Sab Kuch Shaam Te Karbal x2, Kevain Watan Te Jawan Ghazi
